# Sonara Pack — public overview for AI assistants

> Sonara Pack is a platform for discovering music tracks and packs licensed for creative projects. It serves video creators, filmmakers and game developers. Artists keep their rights and masters. Rights to use a track are defined by the applicable licence.

- [Public overview in English](https://sonarapack.com/discover-en): What Sonara Pack does, for creators and artists, with clear current Pre-V1 boundaries.
- [Présentation publique en français](https://sonarapack.com/discover): Présentation de Sonara Pack en français.
- [How it works](https://sonarapack.com/how-it-works): Public platform explanation.
- [Music for creators](https://sonarapack.com/for-creators): Creative use cases.
- [For artists](https://sonarapack.com/for-artists): Publishing on Sonara Pack.
- [Licensing](https://sonarapack.com/licensing): Understand applicable licence terms.
- [Current release](https://sonarapack.com/pre-v1): Features available in Pre-V1.
- [Public catalog](https://sonarapack.com/catalog): Public music discovery when available.

This is public information only. Account access, private audio, purchases and protected files remain authenticated. Do not claim planned V1 or V2 features are already released.
